sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently topping the table with 22 points from 10 games, travel to Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October. Despite their excellent form—winning four of their last five matches with only a draw breaking the sequence—they face a struggling Alsager side anchored at the foot of the table with just 4 points. Sandbach's away visit to Alsager presents a strong opportunity to extend their lead at the top.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host struggling Dawley Town in what should be a favorable fixture for the visitors' pursuers. AFC Bridgnorth, third in the table but having just suffered a loss, travel to Eccleshall (6th place) in a mid-table clash. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth and recently in-form with a win, face Wednesfield Community at home. Bilston Town (6th, in strong form) host Foley Meir in a mid-table encounter. Barnton entertain Shawbury United, with both teams hovering around mid-table. At the foot of the division, bottom-placed Widnes Town visit Brereton Social, while Cheadle Heath Nomads—one from bottom—travel to face Market Drayton Town. Crewe host Allscott Heath in a contest between two lower-table sides. Finally, New Mills travel to Market Drayton Town in another fixture involving sides fighting to move away from the relegation zone.
